captions.detailed: This is a classic upright casino slot machine featuring a tall, deep-red cabinet mounted on a dark-colored base. On the front, it features an orange upper marquee strip decorated with five small white spherical lights, a three-pane window revealing three white spinning reels with a horizontal red line, a coin slot, and a grey payout tray with an orange flap at the bottom. A grey side pull lever with a white spherical handle is mounted on a square base on the right side of the cabinet. The three reels spin continuously on horizontal shafts, the side lever rotates backwards on a revolute joint, and the payout tray flap tilts forward on a bottom hinge.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an upright casino slot machine. The model should have a tall red cabinet, a dark base, a front window displaying three white spinning reels, an orange marquee with small spherical light details, a coin slot, and a lower grey payout tray with an orange flap. Additionally, mount a grey pull lever with a spherical top on the right side of the cabinet, ensuring the reels rotate continuously, the lever rotates on a revolute joint, and the tray flap tilts on a hinge.
captions.factory: The code constructs the slot machine cabinet from a main box with filleted vertical edges and a thin dark base box. An upper marquee is created by combining a thin rectangular box with five small spheres. The three-reel display is constructed using a rectangular frame, transparent glass panels, and three cylinders representing the reels. The side pull lever is built from a square base plate, a cylinder rod, and a sphere handle. The lower payout tray is assembled from a box-shaped bin and a thin orange box representing the flap. The continuous joints for the three reels, the revolute joint for the lever, and the revolute joint for the payout tray flap are defined relative to the main cabinet frame with appropriate axes and limits.
